region_scene_page.standard: Soft rock and AM Gold gather the gentler side of the 1970s pop-rock mainstream: Elton John, Billy Joel, Fleetwood Mac, James Taylor, Carole King, America, and related artists. Piano, acoustic guitar, close drums, and warm backing vocals usually matter more than riffs.
